stories.title: Spain investigates a high-speed collision as the reported death toll reaches 68
stories.summary: Authorities reported at least 68 deaths after two trains collided near Urda. Reporting combined rescue work and survivor testimony with the transport minister's preliminary account of a control-centre decision.
stories.whyItMatters: A second fatal high-speed disaster in one year raised questions about infrastructure safety, public accountability and confidence in a major European transport network.
stories.selectionRationale: High loss of life and international transport implications, documented through national, European and international reporting.
stories.evidenceNote: Reuters, RTVE and Euronews originate these reports. The minister's explanation is an attributed preliminary account, not an established investigative finding. Same-day injury counts describe different categories and are not combined.

stories.title: Israel's partial count leaves both main blocs short of a majority
stories.summary: Successive provisional tallies left neither main bloc with a majority. Arab parties' potential leverage faced political barriers, while outstanding special ballots could still change seat allocations.
stories.whyItMatters: Coalition choices could shape regional security and Palestinian political representation. A partial count cannot establish who will govern.
stories.selectionRationale: A consequential follow-up to election night, balancing counting procedure with interviews about political participation.
stories.evidenceNote: The Times of Israel, Reuters and The New Arab originate the selected accounts. They report different stages of an incomplete count; no single exact seat total is treated as final. A New Arab analysis updated October 29 was replaced with its October 28 ballot explainer.
